description: Evaluation suite for the Wannabe Weekenders setlist builder tool and database constraints.

test_cases.name: Scenario 1: Yacht Rock Preference, target past what the pool can fill

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify that only songs whose genre is in the yacht pool (Yacht Rock / Classic Rock) are scheduled in the sets.
Verify that a warning is displayed showing that the total available music is under the 120 min target.
Verify that 'Roll with the Changes' is scheduled as the closer of the final set (Set 2).
Verify that the break falls back to silent since only 2 acoustic songs are gig-ready and they overlap in performers.
Verify that each set has an emergency cut, and every cut is in the back half of its set, never the set's closer, and never part of a segue chain (check_setlist.py's emergency-cut rule).
Verify that 'Working for the Weekend' is scheduled as the opener of Set 1.
Verify that 'Roll with the Changes' is scheduled as the closer of Set 2.
Verify that the lead vocalist for each song is never listed as a backup vocalist.
Verify that gravelly songs are separated by at least 2 non-gravelly songs (or 1 if relaxed).

test_cases.name: Scenario 3: 3hr Set, David Out, Bar Gig

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify that David is not scheduled for any lead vocals, and Lauren covers his lead vocal parts.
Verify that the Constraints Satisfaction table shows 'Vocalist Balance' as satisfied, even though the detailed percentage breakdown is not published in the report.
Verify that the LEAD VOCALS BREAKDOWN section is NOT present in the output (it is computed internally but not published).

test_cases.name: Scenario 4: 3hr Set, Martin Out, Bar Gig

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify that 'The Chain', 'Landslide', and 'Blackbird' are excluded from the setlist and acoustic breaks (these require Martin's acoustic guitar). Verify that 'Ooh La La', 'Wish You Were Here', 'Ventura Highway', and 'Colors' are NOT cut — they survive without Martin (his part is omitted or covered).

Verify that Martin is not scheduled for any lead or backup vocals, David covers his lead vocal parts on American Girl and Hey Jealousy, and Lauren covers his lead vocal part on Born to Run (a per-song override in substitution_notes).
Verify that the LEAD VOCALS BREAKDOWN section is NOT present in the output (it is computed internally but not published).
Verify that whenever both 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Hey Jealousy' appear in any set or encore, Brown Eyed Girl comes first (per the order_rules canonical segue order).
Verify that acoustic breaks do not contain 'Landslide' or 'Blackbird' (cut songs), and do contain Martin-out-safe acoustic songs such as 'Wish You Were Here', 'Ventura Highway', or 'Ooh La La'.

test_cases.name: Scenario 6: 3hr Set, Martin Out, Acoustic Breaks + File Output

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify that acoustic breaks are populated (not silently fallen back to silent) by using surviving acoustic songs (Wish You Were Here, Ventura Highway, Ooh La La).
Verify that a file named '2099-01-01 Test Venue Eval.md' is written to the setlists/ subdirectory.

Verify that a file named '2099-01-01 Test Venue Eval.txt' is written to the setlists/ subdirectory, containing plaintext arrow notation with 'No Martin' in the header and '->' separators between songs.
Verify that whenever Funkytown, Miss You, Reeling in the Years, and Don't Stop all appear in the same set, they appear in that canonical order (per order_rules).

test_cases.name: Scenario 7: Full Band — Every Present Vocalist Must Lead At Least One Song

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify that Lauren, Jon, Martin, AND David each lead at least one song in the setlist (including encores). No vocalist present at the gig should have zero lead songs.
Verify that even if the vocalist inclusion constraint causes a 3-in-a-row streak for one vocalist, the setlist is still accepted as valid (vocalist inclusion takes priority).

test_cases.name: Scenario 9: Setlist rules and repertoire coverage (October two-set gig)

validation_criteria.assertion: Run scripts/check_setlist.py on the generated .md and verify it reports no ERRORs (WARNINGs are allowed: vocal-run, vocal-health, gig-ready).
Verify every set has at least one emergency cut, each in the back half of the set, never the closer, and not a segue-chain song.
Verify every song printing a 'SEGUE' intro cue is directly preceded by its chain predecessor, and chain members in a set appear in order_rules order.

Verify the scheduled songs (sets, breaks, encores) plus the REQUEST LIST table are exactly the active repertoire — every gig-ready, non-archived, in-season song playable with tonight's lineup appears on exactly one of them, and nothing else appears on the request list.

Verify the last page is '## REQUEST LIST': one flat table, alphabetical by title, numbered 1..N in the '#' column, with columns # | Title | Artist | Key | BPM | Length | Intro | Rec, where Rec holds a '[YT](...)' link to the song's youtube_url.
Verify the '**Totals:**' and '**Lead vocals:**' lines sit above '## SET 1' (the foot of the first page), and that no '## GIG SUMMARY' section exists.
Verify Thriller (seasonal: Halloween) is eligible in October: it appears on either the setlist or the request list.

test_cases.name: Scenario 10: Seasonal song out of season

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify Thriller (seasonal: Halloween) is on neither the setlist nor the request list for a November gig, and that apply_substitution.py refuses '--swap <song> Thriller' on it with an out-of-season error.
Run scripts/check_setlist.py on the generated .md and verify it reports no ERRORs.

test_cases.name: Scenario 11: Rules hold through a hand revision

input_parameters.base: any committed setlist with a REQUEST LIST page
input_parameters.operations: --swap one song, --remove one song, and move an emergency cut by hand

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify apply_substitution.py prints a 'Rule check' result after writing the .md.
Verify the removed song moves to the request list and the swapped-in song leaves it, so setlist + request list still cover the active repertoire exactly.
Verify that moving an emergency cut into the first half of a set (or onto the closer) is reported as an emergency-cut ERROR.
Verify that removing a segue source while its destination still prints a 'SEGUE' cue is reported as a segue-cue ERROR.

test_cases.name: Scenario 12: Request list respects the lineup

validation_criteria.assertion: Verify Ventura Highway (substitution_notes: 'Requires Martin, David AND JJ ... Cut song if any of them is out') is on neither the setlist nor the request list when Martin is out.
Verify no song that substitution_notes says to cut without Martin appears on the request list when Martin is out.
Run scripts/check_setlist.py on the generated .md and verify it reports no ERRORs.
